english.notes: Programme language not confirmed, so the applicable rule is not chosen. 2027 September-entry guidelines (https://admissions.ntu.edu.tw/wp-content/uploads/116-1Admission-Guidelines-for-Intl-Degree-Students_ENG-1.pdf) set university minimums: English-taught programmes 'proof of English proficiency equivalent to CEFR B2 (Vantage) or above'; Chinese-taught programmes 'proof of Chinese proficiency equivalent to CEFR A2 (Waystage) or above'; departments may recommend higher levels in the per-department 2027 programme list (not read). The CSIE department site is primarily Chinese; its bachelor programme is believed Chinese-taught but no page stating the medium was read.

gpa.notes: No grade minimum in the 2027 guidelines: eligibility is a high-school graduation certificate plus transcripts; departments review academically. No numeric threshold for the CSIE bachelor found.
